text: Herein three points are to be noted. First, that we should never peril our whole fortunes on the success of only a part of our forces. Second, that in a well-governed State, merit should never be allowed to balance crime. And third, that those are never wise covenants which we cannot or should not expect to be observed.
author: Niccolo Machiavelli
reference: Discourses on the First Decade of Titus Livius
